description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter app that replicates an Amazon Kindle-like interface. It initializes the app, sets up the MaterialApp with theme customization, and defines a home screen with navigation tabs for 'Library', 'Downloads', and 'Settings'.

classes.name: KindleCloneApp
classes.description: A StatelessWidget creating the primary MaterialApp with theme options and the home screen.

classes.name: _HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the main navigable screen with tabs and content display.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the navigation index and building the Scaffold with AppBar, body, and NavigationBar.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that initializes Flutter and runs the KindleCloneApp widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for _HomeScreenState that constructs the Scaffold with app bar, content, and navigation.
